direction: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
purpose: Renew only the expired frozen-WL and receipt-only support monitors after a 23-run structural accrual gap, without running the transition refit scorer.
required_preconditions: LATEST and the aggregate inventory exactly match the frozen trigger.
The source archive count remains 283 and the continuous intake owner remains live.
All historical WL and receipt PID owners are dead, both locks are free, and both logs end in natural monitor_complete at the frozen prior snapshot.
The transition monitor is not restarted and its state and log remain byte-identical.
No existing WL artifact directory targets the frozen LATEST prefix.
The source worktrees are clean exact commits and all frozen script hashes match.
The config-v2 sidecar filename count remains zero; contents are never opened.

authorized_actions.wl: Start one exact frozen-bundle WL snapshot-chain monitor with 72 polls x 300 seconds and minimum_new_runs=12.
authorized_actions.receipt: Start one exact receipt-only common-support monitor with 72 polls x 300 seconds and stable_polls=3; it may only wait until transition reaches the same snapshot.
authorized_actions.transition: FORBIDDEN in this renewal because the installed transition scorer performs six deterministic HGB fits.
authorized_actions.config_v2: No restart; filename-count metadata inspection only.

postconditions: The first WL observation must bind old=30945550... and new=e9e12c63....
The receipt monitor must start from prior=30945550... and must not read prediction pair files or values.
Both new PIDs and locks must be live/held, unless WL has already completed the frozen snapshot successfully.
Any precondition, hash, lock, PID, first-observation, sidecar, or output-collision mismatch fails closed.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_wl_promotes: The frozen WL escrow has independently verified structural coverage for the promoted snapshot.
forbidden: transition common-support completion before its separately authorized scorer update
